descriptions.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Blue Moon' Blue Moon Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Blue Moon' is an outstanding selection of a full moon Japanese maple that was a sister seedling to the ever-popular Moonrise™. This selection by our good friend, Carl Munn, is quite breathtaking. The spring color of 'Blue Moon' is more bronze, with a more yellow green summer color. The contrast is quite amazing, especially with bronze color new growth over the yellow green full-moon leaves. 'Blue Moon' may reach 8-10 ft in height and width in 15 years. Give 'Blue Moon' protection from the hot afternoon sun. These trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer shirasawanum 'Blue Moon' 蓝月满月日本枫，适生区 5-9。 'Blue Moon' 是一款极为出色的满月日本枫选育品种，与广受欢迎的 Moonrise™ 为同窝实生苗。 这个由我们的好友 Carl Munn 选出的品种十分惊艳。 'Blue Moon' 春季叶色更偏铜色，夏季则转为偏黄绿色。 其色彩对比非常出众，尤其是铜色新梢覆于黄绿色满月形叶片之上时更为醒目。 'Blue Moon' 在 15 年内可长至高、宽约 8-10 英尺。 栽培时应避免炎热午后烈日直晒。 此树仅限到场自提，因植株过大无法邮寄。 MrMaple 苗圃位于北卡罗来纳州 East Flat Rock，详情请联系我们安排提货时间。
